record.paper_title: Some Open Questions on Anti-de Sitter Geometry
record.context_brief: Proper domains for convex cocompact complex AdS actions
record.original_question: Let M be a hyperbolic 3-manifold and let ρ_l,ρ_r : π_1(M) → PSL_2(C) be convex cocompact representations. Is there a maximal domain in the complex anti-de Sitter space X_C on which (ρ_l,ρ_r)(π_1(M)) acts properly discontinuously? What is the topology of the quotient, and how can one recognize geometrically whether the action is proper or non-proper?

evidence.quote: Question 10.3. Let M be a hyperbolic 3-manifold and let (ρl, ρr) be a pair of convex cocompact representations of π1(M) into PSL2(C). Is there a (maximal) domain of XC where the action of the group (ρl, ρr)(π1(M)) ⊂ PSL2(C) × PSL2(C) is properly discontinuous? What is the topology of the corresponding quotient? How can one read geometrically the properness or non-properness of the action of (ρl, ρr)(π1(M)) ⊂ PSL2(C) × PSL2(C) on XC?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $M$ be a hyperbolic 3-manifold with fundamental group $\pi_1(M)$, and let
$$\rho_l, \rho_r : \pi_1(M) \longrightarrow \mathrm{PSL}_2(\mathbb{C})$$
be two convex cocompact representations. Consider the complex anti-de Sitter space
$$X_{\mathbb{C}} = (\mathrm{PSL}_2(\mathbb{C}) \times \mathrm{PSL}_2(\mathbb{C}))/\mathrm{PSL}_2(\mathbb{C}),$$
where $\mathrm{PSL}_2(\mathbb{C})$ is embedded diagonally, and on which $\mathrm{PSL}_2(\mathbb{C}) \times \mathrm{PSL}_2(\mathbb{C})$ acts by left multiplication. The pair $(\rho_l, \rho_r)$ defines a homomorphism
$$\pi_1(M) \longrightarrow \mathrm{PSL}_2(\mathbb{C}) \times \mathrm{PSL}_2(\mathbb{C}), \qquad \gamma \longmapsto (\rho_l(\gamma), \rho_r(\gamma)),$$
with image $\Gamma := (\rho_l, \rho_r)(\pi_1(M))$.

Address the following:

(a) Does there exist a (maximal) open domain $\Omega \subset X_{\mathbb{C}}$ on which $\Gamma$ acts properly discontinuously?

(b) When such a domain exists, describe the topology of the quotient $\Omega/\Gamma$.

(c) Provide a geometric criterion, in terms of the pair $(\rho_l, \rho_r)$, for deciding whether the action of $\Gamma$ on $X_{\mathbb{C}}$ (or on a candidate domain therein) is properly discontinuous or not.
artifact.status_search_result: Web searches surface related developments on convex cocompactness in pseudo-Riemannian hyperbolic spaces, AdS 3-manifolds, and properly discontinuous actions, but no source explicitly resolves the existence of a maximal proper domain in complex AdS space for pairs of convex cocompact PSL_2(C)-representations of a hyperbolic 3-manifold group, nor describes the quotient topology or a geometric properness criterion. The status appears not to be definitively settled in the literature found.

status_evidence.title: Convex cocompactness in pseudo-Riemannian hyperbolic spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Connections between Anosov representations and convex cocompactness in pseudo-Riemannian hyperbolic settings.
status_evidence.claim: Related framework but does not specifically resolve the complex AdS question for pairs of convex cocompact PSL_2(C) representations.

status_evidence.title: Almost strict domination and Anti-de Sitter 3-manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses domination conditions for proper actions in AdS settings.
status_evidence.claim: Addresses related properness questions but in real AdS, not the complex AdS X_C setting of the question.

status_evidence.title: Fundamental domains for free groups acting on anti-de Sitter 3-space
status_evidence.snippet: Fundamental domains for properly discontinuous actions on AdS 3-space.
status_evidence.claim: Provides partial results in real AdS_3 but not the complex AdS quotient topology.
